bar: Match the visual craft of bruno-simon.com's live Three.js scene (lighting, materials, composition — progress/bar/bruno-simon.png) AND the absurd-comedy feel of Goat Simulator 3 (progress/bar/goatsim1.jpg), judged by a cold critic via blind A/B plus the numeric gates below.

pieces.name: core-loop
pieces.gate: sweet-shot bucket hit rate >= 90% over 10 launches; sweetStrain solver converges (|signed distance at rim| < 0.1m)

pieces.name: scene-visuals
pieces.gate: cold-critic blind A/B vs bar images: craft score >= 7/10
pieces.gap: Bright washed-out open field vs the bar's dense dark diorama: meanLum 180 vs 56, structureRatio 15.8% vs 99%, sky 22.7% + flat ground 61.5%; frame needs packed saturated structure / a darker graded palette

pieces.name: hud-legibility
pieces.gate: 0 clipped HUD elements in capture; score/combo/gauge/equip all fully in-frame

pieces.name: juice-fx
pieces.gate: fxParticles >= 20 captured within 500ms of a bucket splat; toast non-empty after score; shake >= 0.15 on hit
pieces.gap: Particle burst captured at ~658ms after the splat toast — outside the 500ms window; needs a shot timed closer to the hit (sweeter capture, not more particles)

history.note: Round 1 = baseline capture. Blender models (11 GLB) + Three.js game + gauntlet harness committed; core loop calibrated (sweetStrain solver, 10/10 hits); visuals 5/10 vs bar. Biggest gap: lighting/shading flatness.

Closed the regressed core-loop win: uncommitted bloom/lighting work dropped SwiftShader to ~9fps; the 50ms dt cap ran the whole sim (incl. the strain gauge) in slow-motion and key-up released from the last physics step up to a full frame late, so real-time releases hit strain 0.17-0.44 vs sweet 0.30 and landed ~1.3m short (0/10). Fixed with a 120Hz fixed-timestep accumulator, strain computed from the DOM key-event timestamp (frame-rate independent, HUD and physics now agree exactly), a flatter launch curve 3.5+9s -> 5.31+1.8s so the HUD's +-0.11 sweet band is the band that actually lands (perfect zone still tight at +-0.06), and quarter-res bloom. Sweet 10/10 all PERFECT (score 13250), hud-legibility also cleared 3 -> 0 clips, performance gate held (1.21ms). scene-visuals re-scored 4/10 by a pixel-measured cold critic (vision critic timed out); its named gap is now the next target: bright washed-out field vs the bar's dense dark diorama (meanLum 180 vs 56, structureRatio 16% vs 99%).
